notes.title: New Languages Added to Fresh Story!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
I’m excited to share that [b]Fresh Story[/b] is now available in even more languages: [b]Turkish, German, Japanese, Korean, Italian, and Greek[/b].[/p][p]These translations were made by passionate fans of the game, so you might notice a few small mistakes here and there. A huge thank you to everyone who contributed! 💖[/p][p]We hope this update makes the game even more accessible to players all around the world.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New languages and updates: getting ready for season three!
notes.content: [p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]We are happy to announce that the first two seasons will receive Korean, German, and Turkish localizations. The new, third season will also be released in these languages from the start.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your interest and support! In the near future, we will update the game, add new languages, and fix some bugs to improve your experience.[/p][p]The third season’s page is currently under moderation and will be available soon. Stay tuned for updates![/p][p][b]Don’t forget to join our [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/8VGFxAZJS6"]Discord server[/url][b] to keep up with the latest news and connect with other players![/b][/p]

notes.title: Update: Chinese is now in the game!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that Chinese has been added to our game. This is an important step for us, and we hope that now even more players will be able to enjoy our story.

We have tried to make the translation as accurate as possible and believe we have conveyed all the nuances of the story and dialog. However, we would appreciate your feedback so that we can improve the localization if necessary.

Keep updating the game and share your impressions. Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Encounter! *Fresh Story* is now available in French!
notes.content:
Encounter! *Fresh Story* is now available in French!

The translation was prepared by one of the fans of the game, so there may be some minor inaccuracies. Let's thank our translator - kedom - for his hard work and enthusiasm!

By the way, I would also like to inform you that the release of the second season has been postponed to December. This is necessary for me to have time to create all the planned content and make it as interesting and high-quality as possible.

I promise that the wait will be worth it!

notes.title: Meet Spanish and Portuguese!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re continuing to improve the game and are excited to let you know that we’ve fixed many narrative errors as well as translation issues. Additionally, we’ve added translations in Portuguese and Spanish. We’re working on adding more languages and will do our best to expand this list soon.

Don’t forget to add the second season to your wishlist — the release is just around the corner!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704140/Fresh_Story_2/

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Brazilian Portuguese translation added
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that we have added Brazilian Portuguese translation! Now many players will be able to enjoy the game in their native language.

Thank you very much for your support on different platforms. We really appreciate your attention and will continue to work on improving the game. As much as we can, we will try to add support for other languages as well.

We also have plans to add more languages in the future, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 09.06.2024
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

We finally got it done! A huge amount of work has been done on the text, and we have fixed a lot of errors in the English translation. Now it will be much more comfortable for English-speaking players to play.

In addition, we have released a multilingual version of the game. We also removed the background behind the text to improve the visual experience.

I hope you enjoy it. Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: News
notes.content:
Greetings to all our players!

I would like to share with you some news about our game. We, as a team, have been working hard lately to create the second part of the game, and in the process we have overlooked some issues with the first part of the game a bit.
However, we are now focusing on fixing those issues to ensure you have the most enjoyable gaming experience possible. After all, your enjoyment of the game is of the highest priority to us.
In addition, we are happy to announce that we are currently working on translations of the game into English and Chinese. As soon as the translations are ready, we will immediately release an updated version of the game so that you can enjoy the game in your native language.
We want to thank you for choosing our game and for your faith in us. Your support is an important incentive for our team.
And while you are waiting for the update, we invite you to check out the demo version of the second part of the game. We are sure that new exciting adventures and exciting opportunities are waiting for you.
Thank you very much for your patience and understanding!

Regards,
Development Team.

notes.title: Season 2 demo is available
notes.content:
Hey, everybody. The demo for season 2 is out, you can download it on the[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704140/Fresh_Story_2/] Fresh Story 2 page[/url]. I hope you like it. 



The first season update is postponed until March.

notes.title: February Update
notes.content:
Hey, everybody. Thanks to your feedback, I have noticed bugs in the game. Errors in translation and narrative line. A small update will be released in February to fix these bugs. Thank you all for playing.

P.S. In February will be released a demo version of the second season, which will include the first 3 episodes. It will be free of charge.
